content.comment_body: I'm new to [product_name]. I purchased a starter kit with [product_name] and [product_name]. I've assigned an IP address to the [product_name] and can ping it, but I can't reach the [product_name]. I only have its MAC address. How do I assign or discover its IP address? If it already has an IP address I don't know, can I reset it? How can I access it from my PC with just an ethernet cable? Thank you :-)
From the main menu of the [product_name], choose "[product_name] Selection" and press OK. Then enter the IP address for the [product_name].
So are you suggesting I enter the desired IP address for the [product_name]? I tried that, but unfortunately it didn't work :-(
What is the current IP address and subnet mask of the [product_name]? What is the IP address and subnet mask of the [product_name]?

You need separate IP addresses for the [product_name] and the [product_name]. Additionally, the [product_name] has to be configured with the [product_name]'s IP address; otherwise, communication won't work. If you haven't changed any settings and use the kit as provided, they should communicate by default with: [product_name]: 192.168.0.1, [product_name]: 192.168.0.2. To find the [product_name]'s IP address if it's unknown and you have only the basic module, connect it directly to your PC with a patch cable. Start [product_name] software and go to network project mode, then select "Go Online." If only one interface is active on your PC, the software should detect the [product_name], no matter its IP address, and display it. To change its IP address, open its properties in the network view and adjust as needed. The [product_name]'s IP settings need to be configured directly at the device.
Thank you everyone! It turned out that a faulty network cable between the [product_name] and [product_name] was the issue. Now I'm online and can continue exploring this intuitive product.

analysis.insight_summary: New users face challenges identifying and configuring the IP address for the [product_name], especially when working with a starter kit over Ethernet. The main difficulties revolve around understanding the process for establishing device communication, using available tools, and troubleshooting physical connectivity. Clear onboarding and effective device/network discovery are key areas for improvement.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants an easy way to set or find the [product_name]'s IP address and connect to it via Ethernet, ideally with clear instructions and reliable hardware and software connectivity from the beginning.
